heat verb

also warm, warm (verb), warm up (food)

classical

Traupman 404

calefaciō, calefacere

verb, third conjugation

heat or make warm

Other words

  • calor, calōris m.

    noun, third declension · classical

  • tepefaciō, tepefacere, tepefēcī, tepefactum — warm slightly, make lukewarm

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. N.D. 2.26: mollītur tepefactus (Lewis & Short s.v. tābēscō); Traupman 404

Examples

  • Apertō furnō calor odorque exiērunt; crusta aurea appāruērunt.

    When the oven was opened, out came the heat and the smell; the pies appeared, golden.Libellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

See also cool, cook, boil, hot.
